composition_variation: A gorgeous original adult woman aged 27 in precise sophisticated anime style. Long violet-black hair with electric lavender ends, deep turquoise eyes, fine lashes, graceful adult face, direct confident eye contact and a warm mischievous smile. She sits sideways on a broad mint-green architectural step: one hand supports her beside her body, the other rests on the nearer knee. Both knees point diagonally to the same side, one leg relaxed down toward a lower step, the other bent with its foot one step higher. Her shoulder, hip, knee and ankle form a compact zigzag, clearly different from standing. Keep natural comfortable secure coverage. Outfit: opaque lavender sleeveless round-neck summer top, dark purple relaxed mid-thigh shorts, mint canvas sneakers. Camera slightly above eye line at three-quarter side angle; full seated figure is large and centrally arranged. A saturated coral-orange wall, one crisp magenta diagonal shadow and turquoise-to-mint steps. Violet hair strongly contrasts orange with luminous aqua edge light. Especially precise and clear face, jewel-like irises and warm skin gradients. Upper quarter stays a calm solid coral glow. Bold geometric fashion composition, empty hands.
